reported.title: No sensor fault detection
reported.description: The behaviour requires forcing the compressor OFF when the probe is floating or reads below 0 °C or above 60 °C, but the sketch never checks for these conditions, so a disconnected probe (raw near 0 or floating) can leave the compressor running or cycling incorrectly.

reported.title: Floating probe not detected
reported.description: A floating A3 input reads an arbitrary value; without a plausibility check the sketch treats it as a valid temperature and may command the compressor ON, violating the failsafe requirement.

reported.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V
reported.description: readTempC uses 5000.0f/1023.0f, which is only correct with a 5 V reference; on the Uno default reference this is approximately right, but the code should use the actual AVcc reference and 1024 divisor for accurate 10 mV/°C scaling, otherwise temperature is slightly off and band crossings shift.

reported.title: Failsafe not applied within 500 ms
reported.description: Even if a fault check were added, the current loop only acts on temperature every 50 ms with a 3-sample hold; the fault path must bypass the hold and force OFF immediately to meet the 500 ms requirement.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D7 must stay 0 during sensor fault ({'pin': 'A3', 'op': '>', 'value': 60}) (Overrange forces OFF)

judge_input.spec:
- Cabinet probe on A3 at 10 mV/°C; compressor relay on D7; service stop on D4 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Turn the compressor ON when temperature reaches 8.0 °C or above, and OFF when temperature falls to 4.0 °C or below.
- If the sensor is floating, or temperature reads below 0.0 °C or above 60.0 °C, force the compressor OFF within 500 ms.
- While D4 is held LOW, keep the compressor OFF for service.
- Print `cooler: <temp> C comp=ON` or `cooler: <temp> C comp=OFF` every 1000 ms.
- Reach the commanded compressor state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D7 must stay 0 during sensor fault ({'pin': 'A3', 'op': '>', 'value': 60}) (Overrange forces OFF)
